title: Mine-Live Drop 26.2
description: This mod adds the biome shown in Minecraft Live Drop 26.2. Now you can preview how it will feel in-game.
body:
**The mod will add the sulfur cave biome shown on Minecraft Live.** 

The mod includes the biome, sulfur blocks, cinnabar, and their variations. I should mention that the mod doesn't include the sulfur cubes and their mechanics, as I haven't had time to implement them yet and lack the necessary coding knowledge. I'll try to add them in the future.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/KIQsEfxM4nE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

The mod already has localizations for:

- English
- Russian
- Ukrainian
- Belarusian
- Japanese
- Pre-reform Russian
- LoLCat - language

**I hope you enjoy the experience this mod will give you, but don't judge me too harshly because I'm just a beginner modder.**
